name: Optimization for Data Science and Signal Processing
description: Review of linear algebra, convex sets and functions; convex optimization problems: linear programming (LP), quadratic programming (QP), quadratically constrained quadratic program (QCQP), second-order cone programming (SOCP), and semidefinite programming (SDP); usage of disciplined convex programming tools in MATLAB/python; Lagrange duality, Karush–Kuhn–Tucker (KKT) conditions and their applications, gradient descent, Newton’s method, ADMM, and coordinate descent, among others; applications-signal processing, communications and radar: compressed sensing, phase retrieval, and radar sequence design, among others. Data science, machine learning and statistics: covariance estimation, logistic regression, and matrix completion, among others.
